summary: Verified the global scanner architecture refactor and History.js TODAY-badge timezone fix via live browser testing. Both fixes work correctly.
action_items: No action items - both target fixes verified working. Optional: consider using data-testid on Scanner tab buttons (currently only text/emoji labels) to make automated regression testing more reliable for future agents.
critical_code_review_comments: useGlobalScanner.js and App.js correctly implement app-global polling: useGlobalScanner() is called once in App.js and the `scanner` object is passed down as a prop to Dashboard and Scanner routes, so setInterval for the 60s auto-scan lives at the App root and survives route changes (React Router only swaps <Routes> children, App itself never unmounts).

History.js getETDateKey() uses toLocaleDateString('en-CA', {timeZone: 'America/New_York'}) to get a YYYY-MM-DD key, and isToday is computed by comparing day.dateKey === getETDateKey(new Date()) per row instead of assuming row index 0 is 'today' - this is the correct fix.
Dashboard.js now purely consumes scanner.results/scanner.lastScanTime via props instead of an independent fetch - confirmed no duplicate/independent scan calls from Dashboard.

manual_test_results.global_auto_scan_background_test: PASS - Enabled Auto-Scan on Scanner page (scan count=1, 75 results), navigated to Dashboard, observed a /api/scanner/scan network request fire in the background while sitting on Dashboard (confirmed via request listener), waited 70s, then navigated back to Scanner: scan count incremented 1->2, results remained populated (75, same underlying data), 'Last scan' timestamp updated, and 'Next scan in Xs' countdown was live and correct. This proves the scan loop survived the page navigation and ran while NOT on the Scanner page.
manual_test_results.dashboard_shared_scanner_data: PASS - Dashboard's 'Scanner Opportunities' card showed the same result count (75) and same Top-5 stocks (VEEE, FGI, KPLT, MIMI, VSOL) as the Scanner page, with 'Updated Xs ago' text correctly ticking up in real time (12s -> 21s) confirming it reads scanner.lastScanTime from the shared hook, not a separate fetch. Positions (BCARU, 1 open position) and Recent Orders sections rendered correctly from the new global 30s poller in App.js.
manual_test_results.history_today_badge_fix: PASS - Current ET date evaluated in-browser as 2026-07-13. The Daily P&L Tracker's top row is 'Mon, Jul 13, 2026' and correctly shows the TODAY badge; other rows (Fri Jul 10, Sun Feb 1) do not show the badge. Weekday labels (Mon, Fri, Sun) are computed with America/New_York timeZone option, consistent with US trading day convention.
manual_test_results.regression_checks: Settings page loads correctly with strategy info and masked API keys. Manual scan button correctly labeled 'RUN MANUAL SCAN' (disabled while auto-scan active, as expected). Scanner page tabs (Top Gappers/Gainers/Volume/Momentum/News/Ready to Trade) render correctly with counts. No new console errors observed across Dashboard, Scanner, History, Settings navigation during the entire ~2 min session.
manual_test_results.tab_click_automation_note: Automated Playwright text-selector clicks on the 6 scanner tab buttons failed due to emoji prefixes in button text (e.g. '🚀 Top Gappers') not matching plain text selectors - this is a test-script selector limitation, not an app bug. Tabs were visually confirmed rendering correctly with proper active/inactive styling in earlier screenshots.

test_credentials: API_ACCESS_TOKEN provided in review_request, worked correctly on token-gate screen
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded trade history data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both target fixes (global scanner hook + History ET-timezone TODAY badge) are verified working via real browser testing including the risky 70s background-scan-while-on-Dashboard scenario. No regressions found in Settings, manual scan, or navigation. Dashboard shows Portfolio Value/Buying Power as $0.00 on very first load before account fetch completes (brief flash) - not a bug, just initial state before the 30s poller's first fetchAccount() resolves; resolved within ~1-2s.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found, this was a verification pass of prior fixes
